script_span:
The harbor light went dark.
A merchant ship was heading straight for the rocks.
Aelia grabbed the last burning lantern.
She ran for the tower.
Felix caught the rope.
The wind nearly pulled it from her hands.
Together they raised the flame above the storm.
Its glow showed the sailors a safe way home.
The ship made it through.
